facts.value: Social media can offer a support system for adolescent health, allowing them to mobilize around health issues they deem relevant.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (Women and Gender Studies) - BA

facts.value: In a clinical study among adolescent patients undergoing obesity treatment, participants claimed that social media allowed them to access personalized weight-loss content as well as social support among other adolescents with obesity.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (Women and Gender Studies) - BA

facts.value: Social media typically has no mechanism for ensuring the quality of health information.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (Women and Gender Studies) - BA

facts.value: The National Eating Disorders Association reported a high correlation between weight loss content and disorderly eating among women influenced by inaccurate content.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (Women and Gender Studies) - BA

facts.value: Health literacy offers skills to allow users to spot/avoid inaccurate health content.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (Women and Gender Studies) - BA

facts.value: Efforts by governments and public health organizations to advance health literacy reportedly achieved limited success.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (Women and Gender Studies) - BA

facts.value: The role of parents and caregivers who proactively approach their children with ongoing guidance and open discussions on the benefits and difficulties they may encounter online demonstrates some reductions in overall anxiety and depression among adolescents.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (Women and Gender Studies) - BA

facts.value: Social media such as pro-anorexia sites reportedly increase risk of harm by reinforcing damaging health-related behaviors through social media, especially among adolescents.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (Women and Gender Studies) - BA
